title: document_extract progress contract
description: One JSON object per line on stdout, interleaved with human-readable status text. A consumer follows extraction by parsing only these lines; the human lines are a rendering and carry no contract. Enforced by document_extract.contracts.validate_progress_event.

event.description: run: the extraction as a whole. page: one page finished or failed. page_stage: one stage within a page.

stage.description: Required for page_stage. One of the pipeline stage names.

error_type.description: Exception class name only. A raw exception message is never published here.

detail.description: Safe scalar counts and codes. Never a file path, prompt, or model response.
